subject: Energy
title: Private Fusion Startups
description: A quick win: understand Private Fusion Startups.

hook.text: Dozens of private companies are racing to build fusion reactors—collectively raising over $6 billion in investment.

buildup.text: Companies like Commonwealth Fusion, TAE, and Helion pursue varied approaches—each betting on different physics.

discovery.text: High-temperature superconducting magnets are a game-changer—they're smaller and stronger, enabling compact reactors.

twist.text: Several startups promise commercial fusion by the mid-2030s—but the joke is fusion is always 30 years away.

climax.text: Private funding brings urgency and innovation—but plasma physics doesn't care about investor timelines.

punchline.text: Billions bet on taming the Sun—the race is real this time.

quiz.question: What technology is enabling more compact fusion reactor designs?
